北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京体感 34℃，晴朗炎热，记得防晒补水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing feels 34°C, sunny and hot. Remember sun protection and hydration!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪体感 35℃ 炎热，请多补充水分，小心中暑哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi feels 35°C, very hot. Please drink more water and prevent heatstroke!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海体感 39℃ 超热，多饮水，注意防暑降温哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai feels 39°C, extremely hot. Drink more water, stay cool!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州中雨，路面湿滑，外出记得带伞，注意安全呀！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Moderate rain in Guangzhou, roads are slippery. Take an umbrella and stay safe!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感 32℃，湿度高，请注意防潮防闷热！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels 32°C, high humidity. Watch out for dampness and stuffiness!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州体感 35℃，晴朗炎热，请注意防暑降温补水！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou feels 35°C, sunny and hot. Remember to stay cool, prevent heatstroke & hydrate!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京体感 36℃，阴天也闷热，注意防暑，及时补水！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing feels 36°C, cloudy and stuffy. Prevent heatstroke and hydrate promptly!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都体感 36℃ 阴天，请注意防晒，小心闷热不适！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu feels 36°C, cloudy. Please protect from sun and beware of stuffiness!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉体感 36℃ 阴天，闷热难耐，多喝水，小心中暑！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan feels 36°C, cloudy and stifling. Drink more water, beware of heatstroke!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安体感 29℃，多云适宜，外出注意防晒，保持好心情！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an feels 29°C, pleasant and cloudy. Protect from sun when out, keep a good mood!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆体感 38℃，多云也炎热，请务必防暑，多饮水！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing feels 38°C, cloudy but hot. Be sure to prevent heatstroke and drink plenty!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 23℃，风力 4级，外出注意防风，小心着凉哦！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels 23°C with a force 4 wind. Watch out for wind when out, avoid catching cold!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳体感 27℃，晴朗舒适，享受美好天气，保持好心情！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang feels 27°C, sunny and comfortable. Enjoy the lovely weather, stay happy!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明体感 23℃，多云凉爽，外出记得带件薄外套哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming feels 23°C, cloudy and cool. Remember to bring a light jacket when out!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门体感 28℃，多云有风，海边游玩注意安全，小心潮湿！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen feels 28°C, cloudy with wind. Be safe when playing by the sea, watch out for dampness!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛体感 30℃，阴天舒适，请注意防晒，保持愉悦心情！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao feels 30°C, cloudy and comfortable. Please protect from sun, stay joyful!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连体感 31℃，晴朗舒适，享受阳光，注意补水防晒！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian feels 31°C, sunny and comfortable. Enjoy the sun, remember hydration & sun protection!
